notes.title: v1.0.9 Patch Note
notes.content: Minor QoL updates related to switching between fullscreen/windowed modes

notes.title: v1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Perfect Mode has been removed from Story Mode. Easy Mode has been added, and Easy Mode is now the default game mode in Story Mode.
[*] Fixed several bugs.
[*] Minor QoL updates.[/list]
[h3][strike]Known Issue[/strike][/h3]
[list][*] [strike]Leaderboard in Challenge Mode not working properly (Unable to save and load records)[/strike] Fixed[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Now the mouse cursor will be hidden from the screen if you leave it for a while.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound effects of electric traps continues to play, even while the game was paused.[/list]

notes.title: Day One Patch (v1.0.1.1) Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Enabled [b]Perfect Mode[/b] (Clear all stages in Normal Mode to unlock)
[*] Improved sound effects[/list]
